create_adafactor_optimizer: create an Adafactor optimizer instance for PyTorch model parameters with configurable learning rate and decay
run_adafactor_step: run a single optimization step using the Adafactor optimizer to update model parameters
review_adafactor_config: review the Adafactor optimizer configuration including eps, clip threshold, decay rate, and weight decay settings
build_fairseq_adafactor: build a FairseqAdafactor optimizer wrapper that registers adafactor arguments with the Fairseq argument parser
test_adafactor_relative_step: test the Adafactor optimizer relative step learning rate scheduling with warmup initialization
